Manage the execution of the communications strategy and lead rapid response efforts
Supervise other communications staff
Oversee day-to-day press activities, including responding to media inquiries, booking interviews, and pitching news stories to media outlets
Manage media and stakeholder communications staff relationships
Work with policy staff to develop core messaging and talking points and identify opportunities for media engagement
Lead development and production of press releases, speeches, op-eds, statements, advisories, and caucus messaging guides, and other materials that are at or near finished product
Lead coordination, preparation, and execution of media interviews, speaking engagements, and press conferences

Demonstrated understanding or experience with veterans and military issues

description: Representative Raul Ruiz, M.D. is a Senior Member of the Energy and Commerce Committee and former Chair of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus. Interested and qualified candidates for the position of Executive Assistant and Scheduler in his Washington, D.C. office. This is not an entry-level position. Salary is commensurate with experience; the office offers competitive and comprehensive benefits. The Executive Assistant and Scheduler will manage the Congressman's schedule from DC to California and support the smooth daily operations of the office, reporting directly to the Chief of Staff. This role works closely with the Chief of Staff, District Director, Legislative Director, and Communications Director to ensure all scheduling needs are met and the Member stays on schedule throughout the day. Additionally, the Executive Assistant serves as the direct administrative assistant for the Congressman managing the Member's schedule, logistics, personal office, workflow, and information needs. We are looking for someone who thrives under pressure, takes pride in precision, and brings energy, optimism, and grit to the job every day. The ideal candidate will develop in-depth knowledge of the district and key stakeholders to meet the office's strategic goals and priorities.
responsibilities: Coordinate, maintain, and execute the Congressman's daily schedule, ensuring proper time allocation for preparation, travel, and transitions between meetings and events.
Serve as the primary entry point for constituents and stakeholders seeking to engage the office.
Perform intake and internal processing of all D.C. and district scheduling requests in a timely manner; ensure district requests are coordinated with the district team.
Track and manage RSVPs, invitations, and event logistics; ensure the Member is appropriately staffed for all meetings and events.
Anticipate and troubleshoot scheduling conflicts in real time, adjusting priorities as needed in a fast-moving environment.
Manage last-minute changes, cancellations, and urgent requests with professionalism and discretion.
Ensure briefing materials are prepared and provided for each event and meeting, and that staff receive appropriate advance notice.
Arrange all official travel for the Congressman and ensure travel logistics are properly coordinated.
Draft and manage follow-up correspondence, including thank-you letters and scheduling confirmations.
Manage Member reimbursements, office purchase card, and asset management.
Implement and maintain scheduling protocols and best practices to improve office efficiency.
Ensure compliance with all office policies, procedures, and practices.
Supervise Staff Assistant, including providing feedback and conducting performance reviews.
Perform additional duties as assigned by the Congressman and Chief of Staff.
qualifications: A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
Exceptional organizational, communication, and attention-to-detail skills.
Strong multitasking abilities and follow-through; demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
Sound judgment and the ability to anticipate challenges before they arise.
Proficiency with video conferencing and meeting platforms and scheduling tools.
The ability to work collaboratively in a team setting while maintaining professionalism under pressure.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including long hours, nights, and weekends.
California ties are a plus.
how_to_apply: All interested candidates are encouraged to submit a resume and cover letter with "Executive Assistant and Scheduler – Last Name" as the subject line to CA25resumes@mail.house.gov.
equal_opportunity: This office is an equal opportunity employer; we do not discriminate.

Congressman Davis lives by a simple motto - meet people where they are - and we're looking for a storyteller who does the same: someone who can capture the people, places, and priorities of eastern North Carolina. This is not an entry-level position, and it is based full-time in the community and district offices.

You will set the communications agenda, shape the Congresswoman's public voice, manage a small and talented team, and be a key thought partner to the Chief of Staff, Legislative Director, and District Director. The ability to maintain a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends as necessary—with the ability to flex time during slower periods—is essential. Dexter's Portland-based district is highly engaged, and her communications operation needs to match that energy. This is a fun office that moves fast, takes the work seriously, and believes that good communication is itself a form of advocacy. This is not an entry-level position. Salary starts at $95,000 and is commensurate with experience and qualifications. The office also offers a competitive package of benefits (health insurance, student loan repayment, and more).
